perArchetype.name: Apex
perArchetype.effect: Gain Mend 1/Life (ex) and Sleight of Mind (Self) 1/Life (ex)
perArchetype.limitation: Loses all instances of Evolution, Hold Person, Pinning Arrow, and Adaptive Protection.

perArchetype.name: Artificer
perArchetype.effect: May wield a Small shield. Gain Greater Mend 2/Refresh Charge x10 (ex). Mend becomes 2/Life Charge x3 (ex). Casting Mend on weapons or shields does not consume a use of Mend.
perArchetype.limitation: Rather than the normal amount of Specialty Arrows for an Archer, gain: - Pinning Arrow 3 Arrows / Unlimited (ex) - Phase Arrow 1 Arrow / Unlimited (ex) - Suppression Arrow 1 Arrow/ Unlimited (ex) Look the Part becomes a fourth Pinning Arrow.
perArchetype.note: Player must still have a use of Mend remaining to cast on weapons or shields.

perArchetype.name: Avatar of Nature
perArchetype.effect: All the casters Enchantments of level 4 and below are now range Self instead of their previous range. Does not apply to Golem.

perArchetype.name: Battlemage
perArchetype.effect: Use of Ambulant becomes unlimited.
perArchetype.limitation: May not purchase Enchantments or Magic Balls.

perArchetype.name: Berserker
perArchetype.effect: Gain Momentum Unlimited (ex) (Ambulant).
perArchetype.limitation: May not wear Armor, and loses all instances of Blood and Thunder.

perArchetype.name: Combat Caster
perArchetype.effect: Does not require an empty hand to cast abilities

perArchetype.name: Corruptor
perArchetype.effect: Gain Void Touched (Self) 2/Refresh (m). All uses of Terror become 1/Life Charge x10 (m).
perArchetype.limitation: May not wield Great Weapons or Javelins and loses all instances of Flame Blade.

perArchetype.name: Dervish
perArchetype.effect: Equipment costs are doubled. Each Verbal purchased gives double the uses. Example: 1/Life Charge x3 becomes 2/Life Charge x3, 2/Life becomes 4/Life, 1/Refresh becomes 2/Refresh.

perArchetype.name: Evoker
perArchetype.effect: May not purchase Verbals with a range of 20' or 50'. Elemental Barrage becomes Charge x10.
perArchetype.note: Elemental Barrage must still be purchased.

perArchetype.name: Guardian
perArchetype.effect: Gain Imbue Shield (Touch) 1/Life (m) and Martyr (Other) 2/Life Charge x3 (ex).
perArchetype.limitation: Loses all instances of Protection from Magic and Extend Immunities. May only have one instance of Imbue Shield active at a time.

perArchetype.name: Hunter
perArchetype.effect: May wield Great weapons and Javelins. Pick one: -Hold Person becomes 1/Life Charge x3 (m). -Pinning Arrow becomes 2 Arrows / Unlimited (ex)
perArchetype.limitation: May not wield shields. Loses all instances of Release and Evolution.
perArchetype.note: You only gain the benefit of an option if you already have that ability.

perArchetype.name: Infernal
perArchetype.effect: Gain Fireball 2 Balls / Unlimited (m). Flame Blade becomes (Self) 2/Refresh Charge x5.
perArchetype.limitation: May not wield shields. Lose all instances of Steal Life Essence.

perArchetype.name: Inquisitor
perArchetype.effect: Gain Sacred Blades (Self) 1/Life (ex)
perArchetype.limitation: Player loses all instances of Greater Resurrect.

perArchetype.name: Juggernaut
perArchetype.effect: Replace Harden with Greater Harden (Self) (ex) at the same frequency. Gain Phoenix Tears (Self) 3/Refresh (ex) (Swift) and Imbue Armor (T).
perArchetype.limitation: Loses all instances of Ancestral Armor and True Grit.

perArchetype.name: Legend
perArchetype.effect: Each Extension purchased gives double the uses. Example: 1/Life becomes 2/Life. Swift may not be purchased or used.

perArchetype.name: Marauder
perArchetype.effect: Gain Momentum Unlimited (ex) (Ambulant). Insult becomes 1/Life Charge x5 (m) (Ambulant).
perArchetype.limitation: Maximum Armor becomes 4pts. May not wield Large shields. Ancestral Armor is no longer chargeable.

perArchetype.name: Medium
perArchetype.effect: Gain Blessing Against Wounds (Touch) 1/Life (ex), Sever Spirit 1/Life Charge x3 (ex), and Swift 2/Life (ex). Abilities in the Spirit school become Charge x3.
perArchetype.limitation: May not wear Armor and may not wield Great weapons.

perArchetype.name: Mystic
perArchetype.effect: Gain Force Bolt 4 Balls / Unlimited (m). Gain Suppression Bolt 2 Balls / Unlimited (m).
perArchetype.limitation: May not wield Heavy Thrown. Lose all instances of Resurrect.

perArchetype.name: Necromancer
perArchetype.effect: All abilities purchased in the Death School become Charge x3. You may have a combined total of five Undead Minion Enchantments.
perArchetype.limitation: You may not purchase any abilities from the Protection School.

perArchetype.name: Priest
perArchetype.effect: Meta-Magic may only be used on Spirit abilities. All Meta-Magics purchased become 1/Life Charge x3. Heal costs zero points.

perArchetype.name: Raider
perArchetype.effect: Gain Bear Strength (Self) 1/Life (ex). Look the part becomes an additional use of Brutal Strike.
perArchetype.limitation: Loses all instances of Rage.

perArchetype.name: Ranger
perArchetype.effect: May use Bows. The cost of all available Equipment is reduced to zero points. Enchantment costs are doubled.

perArchetype.name: Rogue
perArchetype.effect: Regain a use of Coup de Grace upon killing a player with a thrown weapon.
perArchetype.limitation: May not wield Long weapons or Bows.

perArchetype.name: Sniper
perArchetype.effect: May physically carry any number of Specialty Arrows of each type. The frequency of each type of Specialty Arrow ability becomes 1 Arrow/Life Charge x3. Gain Momentum Unlimited (ex) (Ambulant). Look the part becomes Mend 1/Life.
perArchetype.limitation: May not fire normal arrows.

perArchetype.name: Spy
perArchetype.effect: Blink and Shadow Step become Charge x3 (ex).
perArchetype.limitation: May not wear Armor.

perArchetype.name: Summoner
perArchetype.effect: Each Enchantment purchased gives double the uses. Example: 1/Life Charge x3 becomes 2/Life Charge x3, 2/Life becomes 4/Life.
perArchetype.limitation: May not purchase Verbals with a range other than Touch or Self. May not purchase equipment beyond 2nd level.

perArchetype.name: Warder
perArchetype.effect: All abilities purchased in the Protection School give double the uses. Example: 1/Life Charge x3 becomes 2/Life Charge x3, 2/Life becomes 4/Life.
perArchetype.limitation: Player may not purchase any abilities from the Death, Command, or Subdual Schools.

perArchetype.name: Warlock
perArchetype.effect: Each Verbal purchased in the Death and Flame Schools gives double the uses. Example: 1/Life Charge x3 becomes 2/Life Charge x3, 2/Life becomes 4/Life.
perArchetype.limitation: Player may not purchase Verbals from any School other than the Death and Flame Schools.
